CHANGES (list ALL modifications, one or multiple):

Change #1: [Category: Training Strategy]
- What: In data_processing_and_feature_engineering and model_design, replace endpoint-only supervision with joint endpoint and masked-history supervision: always mask the endpoint, additionally mask 15% of preceding nonpadding tokens, and optimize the existing sampled-softmax loss averaged across all masked positions. Keep the current 768-position supervision cap and leave inference unchanged.
- Why: The current model learns from only one target per sampled history, leaving most encoded positions without direct supervision; additional training-only targets can improve item representations without adding another model.

---

WHY current solution limited:
- Root cause: Endpoint-only supervision may provide insufficient learning signal for the bidirectional encoder, particularly when repeatedly sampling the same final endpoints.
- Evidence: The supplied code supervises exactly one position per sequence, and this trial achieved macro validation HR@10 of 0.450 versus the SASRec baseline’s 0.505, with CDs_and_Vinyl falling from 0.480 to 0.335; these results motivate the hypothesis but do not establish its cause.

HOW these changes address it:
- Mechanism: Reconstructing additional masked training items supplies more representation-learning targets per encoder pass, while retaining endpoint supervision preserves the next-item objective.
- Expected improvement: Predict an increase above 0.450 macro validation HR@10, with particular attention to recovery on CDs_and_Vinyl; accept the change only if the pinned host evaluation confirms improvement.
- Synergy: Both objectives update the same embeddings and encoder within one jointly trained network per category.

KEEP UNCHANGED (must explicitly list):
- Random seed: preprocessing seed=0; training seed=42; evaluation seed=42.
- Data split: identical supplied training and validation splits; auxiliary targets come exclusively from training histories.
- Model architecture, endpoint sampling distribution, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, 512 sampled negatives, and all other hyperparameters.
- Maximum 200 epochs by default, existing early stopping, and selection of one checkpoint per category.
- All four categories, dataset routing, single-GPU execution, and DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']; artifacts remain beneath the trial directory.
- Validation and prediction use the same endpoint-mask sequence construction and learned scoring function; preserve the predictor writer and one loaded model per category.
- Host evaluation: macro-average HR@10 with 200 validation users per category and 99 unique negatives; no hidden test access or locally generated test submission.
